scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build web
scripts.e2e:banco: prisma generate && cross-env DATABASE_URL=file:./e2e.db prisma migrate deploy && cross-env DATABASE_URL=file:./e2e.db prisma db seed
scripts.e2e: npm run e2e:banco && start-server-and-test e2e:servidores "http-get://localhost:3000/api/health|http://localhost:5173" "cypress run"
scripts.e2e:abrir: npm run e2e:banco && start-server-and-test e2e:servidores "http-get://localhost:3000/api/health|http://localhost:5173" "cypress open --e2e"
